pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **Bubba G has y'all cooked like Sunday BBQ, and Ghost Pepper's got Mustard Boy second-guessin' his sauce.** Gunner's sittin’ pretty at the top with 47 points thanks to Les Bleus and those North African juggernauts, proving that sometimes he does know better than his dog when it comes to pickin' teams. Devin ain't too far behind at 42 points, tryin' to turn the heat up with Spain givin' Austria a proper lesson — Ghost Pepper keepin' the spicy comebacks rollin’. But Mustard Boy, man, Zach thought Saudi Arabia was gonna be unfurlin' oil money on the pitch, but they're playin' like they got stage fright at a middle school talent show, leavin’ him stuck at 35 points. Over in Gayden's camp, The Backpass Assassin's down with 31 points — guess he's been spendin' too much time passin' backwards and not movin' up in the ranks. Then there's The Noisemaker, Rafe, bringin' up the rear; his 29 points are just as chaotic as his draft strategy — pickin' Germany like he thought Oktoberfest came with goals. Today’s all about who’s gonna seize the moment, but if you're Gayden or Zach, you better start draftin' a miracle, 'cause this league ain't slowin’ down.
